observations: Direct Qwen 8B gives three supported substantive answers and four justified exact abstentions across ten repeated-order development trials; this is not a general accuracy estimate.
Direct Qwen 8B improves absent-fact abstention from 0/4 per constrained representation to 4/4, but still makes one role reversal and two unjustified abstentions.

Qwen 4B sends analysis-like text in the ordinary content field while think=False is recorded and reported separate thinking length is zero. Six length-stopped trials exhaust 2048 tokens. Runtime/model/template handling requires separate isolation; this is not proof of the cause.
Four completed Qwen 4B responses end in a correct abstention suffix but include lengthy analysis-like text and wrong story paraphrases. They are not counted as clean responses.
Gemma has factual role errors, self-contradiction, mixed abstention and weak citation support. One correct nonexact birth-date abstention is distinguished from factual failure.

Six Gemma responses use comma-separated citation groups. All component IDs are known. Original strict parser flags the whole group as unknown; this is a format/parser limitation, not fabricated individual source IDs.
Grouped parsing repairs neither factual claims nor semantic citation support; original check outputs are preserved.
Prompt, input representation and output protocol changed together from the matrix. The change does not isolate JSON grammar as the sole cause.
next_step: Run the already reserved synthetic confirmation cases with direct Qwen 8B and the frozen direct prompt/options. Assess outcomes without further tuning; preserve current failures. Do not use the old ID-selection confirmation path.
limitations: Five reused development questions in two orders on one six-page story; not a held-out benchmark.
No new retrieval/ingestion test, no hosted validation.
One generation per trial; no statistical significance claim.
Qwen 4B comparisons confounded by content/channel and output-limit failures.
